role: COMM group (Phase-I autoresearch, temporal state construction summary, plan section 2)

object_definition.S_i(t): all wallet-level information observable strictly before cutoff t
object_definition.Z_i(t): as-of feature vector constructed from S_i(t) (90d lookback, no future)
object_definition.P_i(t): dynamic persona/cluster label from Z_i(t) (Group A) or community label from as-of graph (COMM)

groupA_behavior.S_i(t)_source: wallet_asof_features_20220901 (compact aggregated; 18,519 rows, snapshot 2022-09-01) and wallet_asof_features_v1 (monthly 05-08, 78,786 rows)
groupA_behavior.Z_i(t): 57 feature cols: activity/capital/counterparty/trajectory (100% coverage) + USD (91.3% native, 35.8% token USD) + as-of matched-matched network (42.8%, 7,929/18,519)
groupA_behavior.P_i(t): K-means/GMM/HDBSCAN on standardized 54-col matrix; primary = full_asof K-means K=4 (silhouette 0.236, bootstrap ARI 0.418 [0.410,0.428])
groupA_behavior.windows_monthly: each snapshot in 2022-05-01..08-01 uses its own [t-90d, t) and [t, t+30d)
leakage_notes: static full-window structural prior isolated in static_prior_20220901.csv (leaky, not as-of)
P3 demo label excluded from clustering

groupB_predictive.S_i(t)_source: Group A monthly parquet (wallet_asof_features_v1 06/07/08) + wallet_asof_features_20220901 (09); 09-01 labels from fresh bounded BQ pull (parity 0 diff with Group A)
groupB_predictive.Z_i(t): 24 BASE_FEATURES as-of (activity/capital/counterparty); EXTRA_09 (trajectory/network/USD) only in post-hoc ablation, not frozen OOS
groupB_predictive.P_i(t)_usage: consumes Group A personas for community concentration (top-2 personas hold ~93% of predicted top-10%)

groupC_temporal_graph.G_le_t: as-of matched-matched directed graph [2022-06-03, 2022-09-01): both endpoints EX-Graph-mapped, counterparty_present, not self_transaction; 7,929 nodes / 13,281 undirected edges / event weight 105,592
groupC_temporal_graph.community: greedy_modularity_communities on weighted undirected graph -> 387 communities; boundary (cross_comm_share>=0.5) 799 (10.1%)
leakage_notes: rough monthly switch rate 58.0/56.3 was calendar-month slices with greedy no-threshold matching + overwrite-weight month graphs (see COMM formalization)

groupD_infogain.S_i(t)_source: Group A feature_matrix_20220901.parquet (no new BQ); p1_wallet_icf_v2 (snapshot 08-01) as external proxy table
groupD_infogain.Z_i(t): 52 as-of features (activity/capital/counterparty/trajectory/network/USD); static prior only as baseline
groupD_infogain.IG_definition: IG_i(t) = H(Y|C_t) - H(Y|C_t, X_i(t)) via 5-fold wallet-level CV + occlusion (median-masking) dNLL; out-of-sample
groupD_infogain.sample: representative subset n=2,999 of 18,519 (stratified by y_cp_ge10, seed=20220901)
leakage_notes: single-cutoff wallet-level CV (no cross-window mixing) -> not a walk-forward OOS verdict

cutoff_semantics.note: all use strictly-before-cutoff as-of; 09-01 = final untouched holdout

lookback_90d.note: [t-90d, t) half-open, verified calendar math for 06/07/08/09 cutoffs

matched_matched_edge_filters.note: identical filters (primary, counterparty_present, not self); A aggregates (u,v,direction), C adds month grouping; COMM verified event weight parity 105,592

feature_set.note: A uses 57 cols, B frozen uses 24 base (EXTRA_09 post-hoc), D uses 52; network/trajectory/USD inclusion differs by group - labeled

static_prior.all: kept separate and labeled leaky; never as-of features

social_X.all: not used as features (no reliable eth<->X crosswalk)

known_differences: Group A network subgraph (asof_mm_*) and Group C edge graph use identical source filters and window; Group A covers 42.8% of wallets (7,929/18,519) - Group C computes node-level features only inside that subgraph
Group B frozen OOS uses 24 base as-of features; trajectory/network/USD only in labeled post-hoc ablation (run_extended09.py)
Group D uses 52 features including network/trajectory/USD at single cutoff with wallet-level CV; strictly a within-snapshot predictive-IG estimate, not cross-window OOS

wallet_asof_features_20220901 target pool was built from Mar-Oct combined view (low risk: every row has >=1 event in [06-03,09-01), so no future-only wallet enters; protocol recommends <cutoff for future snapshots)
Group C betweenness is full on 09-01; COMM uses sampled k=1000 seed=42 on 06/07/08 (documented approximation)
